scenes.en: Nila's tablet was too close, every evening
scenes.say: Nila is ten. After every online class, she had a headache and tired eyes. Her tablet was just a hand's width from her face.

scenes.en: Close screens make focusing muscles work hard, and we blink less
scenes.ta: அருகில் திரை இருந்தால் கண் தசைகளுக்கு அதிக வேலை
scenes.say: Here's why. When a screen is very close, the focusing muscles inside the eye work hard non stop. And when we concentrate, we blink less, so the eyes dry out.

scenes.en: Sit at a table, screen at arm's length, top at eye level or a little lower
scenes.ta: மேசையில் உட்கார்ந்து, திரையை கை நீள தூரத்தில் வையுங்கள்
scenes.say: Her mother made three changes. First, sit at a table, not on the bed, with the screen at arm's length, and its top at eye level or a little lower.

scenes.en: Back against the chair, feet on the floor, room lights on
scenes.say: Second, sit tall with the back against the chair and feet on the floor, and keep the room light on.

scenes.en: Every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Play outdoors daily.
scenes.ta: 20 நிமிடத்துக்கு ஒருமுறை, 20 அடி தூரம், 20 வினாடி பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: Third, the twenty twenty twenty rule. Every twenty minutes, look at something twenty feet away for twenty seconds. And play outdoors every day.

scenes.en: Studies show kids who spend more time outdoors are less likely to become short-sighted
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show children who spend more time outdoors are less likely to become short-sighted.

scenes.en: Headaches, squinting or sitting close to the TV? Book an eye test.
scenes.say: If headaches, squinting, or sitting close to the TV continue, your child may need glasses. Book an eye test.
